name: stevecad-mcp__read_design
description:
Read one document's source, revision, links, and latest geometry measurements.

sample (instead of document_id): a built-in sample's source, by list_designs(source="samples")'s sample_id.
path optionally reads just one file ("main.py", "params.py", "components/arm.py"; a circuit's "main.tsx"): the
result is then only the document's identity and revision (`file_names` lists its files) and that file's `content`,
without the other files, model or outline.

A design (kind "design") is a small codebase: `code` is main.py and `files` holds params.py and
components/*.py; `features` then outlines every file, its components and any diagnostics.
A circuit (kind "circuit") is tscircuit TSX: `code` is main.tsx, `files` its other modules, and `circuit` the
last build's board, counts, readiness verdict and diagnostics, grouped by kind (inspect_model lists the built
components and nets).
A shop (kind "shop") is machines, controllers and tools as code: `features` outlines its files and the items each
defines, with its links; `shop` lists the last build's items (key, kind, name, file, line) and counts.
branch optionally names one of this document's branches; omitted means main.
`model.current` says whether the model was built from exactly this revision's source. When it's false the model is
an earlier revision's last good geometry (`model.stale`): its status, measurements and results don't validate this
revision, and `latest_build` reports this revision's own latest attempt and what to do next.
